subject: Analytics
question:
The graph models a rectangle's area against width. One x-unit is 5 meters and one y-unit is 25 square meters. Which statement is true?
Choices:
A:Greater width always means smaller area.
B:Area decreases whenever the width is below 10 meters.
C:At zero width, the area is 20 square meters.
D:At zero width, the area is zero square meters.

choices.A: Greater width always means smaller area.
choices.B: Area decreases whenever the width is below 10 meters.
choices.C: At zero width, the area is 20 square meters.
choices.D: At zero width, the area is zero square meters.

original_question:
The function A models the rectangle's area (in square meters) as a function of its width (in meters). Which of these statements are true?
Choices:
A:Greater width always relates to smaller area.
B:Greater width relates to smaller area as long as the width is less than $10 \mathrm{~m}$.
C:When there is no width, the area is $20 \mathrm{~m}^2$.
D:When there is no width, the area is $0 \mathrm{~m}^2$.
candidate_answer_value: At zero width, the area is zero square meters.
source_answer_value: When there is no width, the area is $0 \mathrm{~m}^2$.
